plugins.name: docs-repair
plugins.description: Documentation repair. metadiscourse-audit finds and removes text whose subject is the document rather than the thing it documents — changelogs written into prose, dated status stamps, caveats buried mid-paragraph, staging tics. ai-slop-audit strips what AI sessions leave in docs — chat residue, completion reports, phantom links, inflation, emoji decoration. lie-detector verifies the factual claims — defaults, flags, guarantees, version requirements — against the code, recording each verdict with the evidence that settled it and re-checking only what a later commit staled.
